props.level-type.hint: World preset: normal, flat, large biomes, amplified or single biome. Only applies to a newly created world.
props.level-type.name: World type
props.max-chained-neighbor-updates.name: Chained update limit
props.max-players.hint: How many players can be online at once. The real ceiling is your CPU and RAM, not this number. Ops with bypassesPlayerLimit in ops.json can join a full server.
props.max-players.name: Max players

props.op-permission-level.hint: The level a player gets after /op. This is only the default for NEWLY created ops — existing operators keep the level stored in ops.json.

props.player-idle-timeout.name: Idle kick
props.prevent-proxy-connections.name: Block proxies/VPN
props.pvp.hint: Player-vs-player combat. Removed from server.properties in 1.21.9 — it is now a game rule: /gamerule pvp false.

props.query.port.hint: UDP port query listens on. Defaults to the same number as the server port.
props.query.port.name: Query port
props.rate-limit.name: Packet rate limit
props.rcon.password.hint: Required when RCON is on: with a blank password RCON refuses to start.
props.rcon.password.name: RCON password
props.rcon.port.name: RCON port
props.require-resource-pack.name: Require resource pack
props.resource-pack-prompt.name: Prompt text
props.resource-pack-sha1.name: Resource pack SHA-1
props.resource-pack.name: Resource pack (URL)
props.server-ip.hint: Blank listens on all interfaces (almost always what you want). Fill it only to bind to a single address.
props.server-ip.name: Bind address
props.server-name.hint: Internal server name; players see the MOTD in the list, not this line.
props.server-name.name: Server name
props.server-port.hint: The TCP port the server listens on. In the launcher it is changed in the “Port” block.
props.server-port.name: Server port
props.simulation-distance.hint: Chunk radius in which mobs, redstone and crops tick. More expensive than view distance: it costs server CPU every tick. Lower this one first.
props.simulation-distance.name: Simulation distance
props.spawn-animals.name: Spawn animals
props.spawn-monsters.name: Spawn monsters
props.spawn-npcs.name: Spawn villagers
props.spawn-protection.hint: Radius of the square around spawn where only ops can build: 16 protects 33×33 blocks, 1 protects 3×3, 0 disables it. With no ops set, it disables itself.
props.spawn-protection.name: Spawn protection
props.sync-chunk-writes.hint: Protects the world from corruption on a crash at the cost of disk throughput. Best left on.
props.sync-chunk-writes.name: Synchronous chunk writes
props.text-filtering-config.name: Text filtering
props.use-native-transport.name: Native transport
props.view-distance.hint: Chunk radius the server sends to each client; a client cannot see further. Higher looks better but costs bandwidth and client memory.
props.view-distance.name: View distance
props.voice.body: The server folder contains a voice mod ({mods}) while the P2P UDP tunnel is off. The mod uses a separate UDP port :{port}, but P2P forwards TCP only — players will join the server, but there will be no voice.
props.voice.how: Turn on “Voice chat (UDP)” on the Network tab (port :{port}) — the mod picks the tunnel up by itself, nothing to change in its config.

settings.analyticsEnabledDesc: The launcher will send depersonalised usage data to the server: how much you played, when you installed the launcher and your in-game nickname. The nickname is encrypted on the server — it is stored encrypted and shown to nobody but the developer. Off by default: no request is sent without your consent.
settings.animationsEnabledDesc: Smooth card transitions, section switching, and active-item highlights. Turn off if animations feel distracting or slow — the interface stays just as usable, only without the effects.
settings.appearance.accentDesc: Color of buttons, progress and active elements
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.autoDownloadAfterCreate: Download components after creating a pack
settings.autoDownloadAfterCreateDesc: Right after creating or importing a pack, automatically download everything needed (Java, loader, Minecraft client, libraries) so the first launch is instant, like in Prism. Enabled by default.
settings.autoUpdateDesc: Automatically update the launcher to a new version
settings.autopacks.deleteConfirmHint: The pack will be deleted completely. You can register it again with the toggle above.
settings.autopacks.footerHint: A disabled auto pack is hidden from lists, but its files stay on disk.
settings.autopacks.hint: Two packs that track the newest Minecraft versions: auto-vanilla follows stable releases, auto-snapshot follows weekly snapshots. When a new version comes out — the config updates itself, files — via the Download button.

settings.consoleAIDesc: Crash cause analysis with artificial intelligence (Gemini): the AI itself determines the problem type, cause and recommended actions from the game log.
settings.consoleAIKeyDesc: Your own Google Gemini key. If empty, the launcher's built-in key is used.
settings.consoleErrorFontDesc: Font of ERROR/Exception lines when “Separate for each type” mode is on
settings.consoleFontFamilyDesc: Monospace — terminal style, or the launcher UI font

settings.disableModSuggestionsDesc: Hide suggested mods in the content tab of instances
settings.disableP2PDesc: Removes P2P from the UI and does not start the background listener on 127.0.0.1:45678. Use it when the feature is not configured on the server yet (no Headscale).
settings.disableMojangSkinFallback: Do not fetch skins from Mojang by nickname
settings.disableMojangSkinFallbackDesc: When Shaurma has no skin for a player, the local skin injector takes the skin of the licensed player with the same nickname from Mojang, so offline players see licensed skins. Turn this on to use the Shaurma server only.
settings.disableSkinsDesc: The launcher will not attach the skin-system java agent and will not call the Yggdrasil API — in-game skins will not work (offline accounts will show the plain Steve). Turn this off if you do not want to use this system.
settings.discordRPCDetailsDesc: Template for the first line. Placeholders: {pack} — build name (or "N builds"), {count} — count, {list} — list of builds, {loader}, {mc}.
settings.discordRPCEnabledDesc: Shows in your Discord profile that you are playing (enabled by default). When several builds run at once — shows "N builds" and lists them in the text.
settings.discordRPCStateDesc: Template for the second line. Same placeholders; defaults to {list}.
settings.envVarsDesc: KEY=VALUE, one per line. Added to the game process and commands

settings.friends.needLicensed: Minecraft friends are available only for licensed Microsoft accounts. Sign in with a licensed account to see this section.
settings.friends.onlineNotifDesc: Show a toast when a friend comes online.
settings.friends.participateDesc: Let others see you and add you as a friend.

props.enforce-secure-profile.hint: Requires players to have a Mojang-signed public key. When off, all chat is unsigned (and unreportable) and clients show a warning on connect.
props.prevent-proxy-connections.hint: Kicks players whose ISP/AS as seen by the server differs from what Mojang’s authentication reports. A rough VPN filter — false positives are possible.
props.accepts-transfers.hint: Whether the server accepts players sent over by another server’s transfer packet. Only relevant for multi-server networks.
props.player-idle-timeout.hint: Minutes without activity before a player is kicked. 0 never kicks. The timer resets on almost any action: moving, chatting, using items.
props.rate-limit.hint: Max packets a player may send before being kicked. 0 disables it. A blunt tool: players on poor connections can trip a low value.
props.chat-spam-threshold-seconds.name: Chat spam threshold
props.chat-spam-threshold-seconds.hint: Budget for the automatic chat-spam kick, decremented every tick (1/20 s). Higher is more permissive, 0 disables the kick. Added in 26.2.
props.command-spam-threshold-seconds.hin: The same mechanism for commands instead of chat messages. 0 disables it. Added in 26.2.
props.enable-code-of-conduct.name: Code of conduct
props.enable-code-of-conduct.hint: The server looks for a codeofconduct folder next to server.properties and shows joining players the file for their language (e.g. en_us.txt), falling back to en_us.txt.
props.generator-settings.hint: JSON that fine-tunes world generation; its content depends on the world type (layers for flat). Only applies to a new world.
props.initial-enabled-packs.hint: Comma-separated datapacks enabled when the world is created (default vanilla). Experimental packs must be listed explicitly. For an existing world use /datapack enable.
props.initial-disabled-packs.hint: Comma-separated datapacks to leave disabled when the world is created. Only applies to a new world.
props.force-gamemode.hint: Off — players rejoin in the mode they logged out in. On — everyone is switched to the default mode on every join.
props.hide-online-players.hint: The status response keeps the player count but omits the names.
props.bug-report-link.hint: URL the client opens for its “report a bug” link. Blank offers no link.
props.use-native-transport.hint: Linux-optimised packet send/receive path. Leave it on.
props.max-chained-neighbor-updates.hint: How many consecutive neighbour block updates are allowed before the rest are skipped. Guards against redstone that locks the tick. Negative disables the limit.
props.pause-when-empty-seconds.name: Pause when empty
props.pause-when-empty-seconds.hint: Seconds with nobody online before the server pauses ticking (near-zero load). Raise it if farms or timers must keep running while nobody is on.
props.region-file-compression.name: Region file compression
props.region-file-compression.hint: Compression algorithm for world files. LZ4 saves CPU for a larger size on disk; existing chunks are recompressed gradually.
props.broadcast-rcon-to-ops.hint: Echo the output of RCON commands to online operators.
props.enable-jmx-monitoring.hint: Exposes the net.minecraft.server:type=Server MBean with tick times. The JVM also needs its own JMX flags.
props.management-server-enabled.name: Management API
props.management-server-enabled.hint: JSON-RPC over WebSocket for managing the server from programs — a newer, safer alternative to RCON. With TLS on and no keystore, the server will NOT start.
props.management-server-host.name: API host
props.management-server-host.hint: Address the API binds to. Keep localhost unless you need remote access.
props.management-server-port.name: API port
props.management-server-port.hint: 0 picks a random port at every start. Set a fixed one if you will connect from outside.
props.management-server-secret.name: API token
props.management-server-secret.hint: Bearer token clients must present: exactly 40 alphanumeric characters. Left blank, the server generates one and writes it back here.
Comma-separated origins browser clients may connect from. Blank means no browser client can connect.
props.management-server-tls-enabled.name: API TLS
props.management-server-tls-enabled.hint: Encrypts the API. Without a keystore the server will not start — set one, or turn TLS off and keep localhost.
props.management-server-tls-keystore.hin: Path to the keystore file (PKCS12 format).
props.management-server-tls-keystore-pas: The PKCS12 password. Safer to pass it via the MINECRAFT_MANAGEMENT_TLS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD environment variable than to store it in a file.
props.status-heartbeat-interval.name: Heartbeat interval
props.status-heartbeat-interval.hint: How often the management API sends heartbeat notifications. 0 disables them.
props.resource-pack.hint: Direct download URL of a resource pack; players are asked to accept it on join. Up to 250 MiB. The client logs download errors, not the server, so a broken URL is invisible in the console.
props.resource-pack-sha1.hint: Lowercase hex digest so clients can verify and cache the pack. Strongly recommended; a mismatch prints “Invalid sha1” in the console.
props.resource-pack-id.name: Resource pack ID
props.resource-pack-id.hint: Optional hyphenated UUID that identifies the pack to clients.
props.resource-pack-prompt.hint: Message shown on the resource-pack prompt (chat-component JSON). Blank uses the default wording.
props.require-resource-pack.hint: Disconnects players who decline the resource pack.
props.log-ips.name: Log player IPs
